Hymn 44: Beautiful Zion, Built Above
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Joseph G. Fones
Lyricist/Text Author: George Gill
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 44 titled "Beautiful Zion, Built Above" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph G. Fones and the lyrics were written by George Gill.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
